headline: Binance Restores 90% of Funds Following $6.3 Billion Security Breach
summary: Binance announced it has replaced 90% of the cryptocurrency stolen in a $6.3 billion breach. The exchange is absorbing all losses using corporate funds, futures reserves, and its SAFU fund to keep user balances intact.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, meaning major security incidents and liquidity management moves across its platform can significantly impact crypto market confidence and trading volumes.
why_moved: A multi-billion dollar security breach on a major exchange can trigger sudden market-wide volatility and liquidity concerns across digital assets.
